initial.name: ask_user
initial.description: Show the user a short multiple-choice question card in the chat (the user can also type their own answer). Calling it ends your turn; the chosen answer arrives later as the user's next message.

label.description: Short answer shown on the option

description.description: Optional one-line explanation under the label

detail.description: Optional one-line context shown under the question

allowCustom.description: Also offer a field for an answer in the user's own words

initial.name: ask_user_question
initial.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

initial.name: attach_capability
initial.description: Attached a shared capability to yourself, or to another Bot if you are a Main Bot.

bot.description: Optional Bot name; only a Main Bot may change another Bot

initial.name: create_bot
initial.description: Main Bot only. Create a new Bot on the user's team. It appears in the sidebar and greets the user.

role.description: Two-to-four character role label shown under the name

instructions.description: What this Bot is responsible for and how it should work

brief.description: Why the user wants it, passed to the new Bot as its first context

preset.description: Registered agent preset for the new Bot. Defaults to short-drama for Muse specialist work; bot-coordinator supplies general coordination.

resident_tools.description: Exact tool names to keep resident for this Bot. Tools remain subject to its existing permissions; it can later search, pin or release them with tool_search and tool_context.

model.description: Model the Bot runs on, as provider/model or a model id. Only when the user names one; otherwise the model you run on.

effort.description: Thinking level for the model, as list_models shows it. Only when the user names one.

work_dir.description: Full path of the folder to work in, where commands and file tools start. Only when the user asks for it

avatar.description: Profile picture: a local image path (a relative path starts in your working folder) or a data URL. PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF; square, 256x256 recommended, up to 120 KB. Images are not resized.

initial.name: create_goal
initial.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

initial.name: create_group
initial.description: Main Bot only. Create a group chat with the user and some Bots. You join it as its admin unless you name another member.

members.description: Exact names of the other Bots to add; you are added automatically

name.description: Group name; defaults to the member names

notice.description: Shared instructions every member reads before speaking in this group

admin.description: Member who leads the group; defaults to you

mode.description: "everyone": every member answers a plain message in turn, admin first. "admin" (the default): a plain message goes to the admin, who calls others with @Name. @mentions always choose who answers.

initial.name: delete_capability
initial.description: Remove a shared capability and detach it from every Bot and pack.

initial.name: delete_group
initial.description: Main Bot only. Delete a group chat; its history is archived. Only when the user asks.

group.description: Exact group chat name from list_bots

initial.name: detach_capability
initial.description: Detached a shared capability to yourself, or to another Bot if you are a Main Bot.

bot.description: Optional Bot name; only a Main Bot may change another Bot

initial.name: edit
initial.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

initial.name: exit_plan_mode
initial.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

initial.name: get_goal
initial.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

initial.name: glob
initial.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

initial.name: grep
initial.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

initial.name: interrupt_agent
initial.description: Ask a subagent to stop its current work. This call returns without waiting for it to stop. You can continue a direct child's conversation later with send_message. Subagents it started will keep running.

agent_id.description: The id of an agent created under you: your direct child or a deeper descendant.

initial.name: job_kill
initial.description: Request cancellation of a running background job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

initial.name: job_list
initial.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

initial.name: job_output
initial.description: Read a background job: output since the previous read for stream jobs, or the result of a finished final-output job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

initial.name: list_agents
initial.description: List subagents you started, with their ids, labels, and status. running means it is working; inactive means it is not currently working. You will be notified when a subagent finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.

scope.description: children (default) lists direct children, which accept send_message in any status. descendants lists the whole tree below you with each entry's parent session id and depth; entries deeper than 1 accept only interrupt_agent.

initial.name: list_bots
initial.description: List every Bot on the user's team with its role, what it does and what it is doing right now, and the group chats you can see.

initial.name: list_capabilities
initial.description: List shared MCP servers, skills, and packs, plus the capabilities attached to you.

initial.name: list_models
initial.description: List the models a Bot can run on, as provider/model refs for create_bot and update_bot. A model in use also lists the thinking levels it serves.

initial.name: message_bot
initial.description: Send a message to another Bot on the team. If that Bot is working, it reads your message at its next step and can change course, then answers once that work is done; if it is idle, it starts on it right away. Its reply arrives later as a new message to you; with reply_to "user" it answers the user in its own chat instead. In a group chat it reaches only members of that group, as writing "@Name" there does. With request_id you name the request yourself: a repeat of that name with the same message is not sent again, but gives the receipt of the first call back.

message.description: Self-contained message; the other Bot cannot see this conversation

reply_to.description: "me" (default): the reply comes back to you and the user does not see it. "user": the Bot answers the user in its own chat, where the user reads it, and nothing comes back to you. Use "user" whenever the user wants to hear from that Bot directly or asks Bots to say something in their own chats.

when.description: "now" (default): a working Bot reads your message at its next step, between its current actions, and answers once its current work is done; use it for questions, information it needs, corrections and warnings. "queue": it reads your message only after its current work is done, as a separate task; use it only for a new task unrelated to what it is doing now. With reply_to "user" the message always queues.

request_id.description: Your own name for this request, up to 200 characters, so that a repeat of it is not sent twice. Send the same request_id with the same message when you repeat a call: the receipt of the first call comes back and nothing is sent again. A request_id names one request: with other content it is refused.

initial.name: post_to_group
initial.description: Post a message into a group chat as yourself. A Main Bot may post into any group, any other Bot into a group it is in. A Main Bot's or the group admin's post starts a round: members reply in the group, where the user reads them. Another member's post calls only the members it names with "@Name"; without one it is only written into the group.

group.description: Exact group chat name from list_bots

message.description: What to say; write "@Name" to choose who answers, and a name without "@" to only mention a member

report_back.description: Also send the members' replies back to you as a new message when the round ends

initial.name: present
initial.description: Declare existing files as final deliverables for the user. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. The user opens the current files; their contents are not copied.

files.description: Usually the 1-2 most important deliverables; at most 4 per call.

path.description: Path of an existing regular file. Relative paths use the Session working directory.

initial.name: read
initial.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

column.description: 1-based Unicode code point column in the first line. Use the continuation cursor for a partial line.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

initial.name: read_image
initial.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. Large images are downscaled automatically; do not install image libraries or create thumbnails to inspect an image.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

initial.name: save_capability
initial.description: Create or update a shared MCP server, skill, or pack. Changes apply from your next message.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits, and single hyphens, up to 32 characters; "github" is reserved

transport.description: How to reach an MCP server: a local command or an HTTP URL

command.description: Program that starts a local MCP server

env.description: Environment variables for command; write $DSH_SECRET_<NAME> to insert a saved secret instead of the value

url.description: MCP server URL; write $DSH_SECRET_<NAME> in the path or query to insert a saved secret, URL-encoded. Prefer headers for keys

headers.description: HTTP headers; write $DSH_SECRET_<NAME> to insert a saved secret instead of the value

items.description: MCP server and skill names in the pack

initial.name: send_message
initial.description: Send a message to an agent. A working agent receives it at its next step; an idle agent starts a new turn with it. Returns delivery confirmation, not the agent's answer.

agent_id.description: The agent id of your direct continuable child, or your direct parent when you are a resident continuable child.

message.description: The message to deliver to the agent.

initial.name: show_view
initial.description: Draw a view in your own chat as part of your reply: a chart, key numbers, a table, a small calculator the user can try values in, or a choice, confirmation or short form. Text you write before and after the call shows around it. Use a view when it answers better than text: a chart to compare values or show a trend, inputs with formulas to let the user try numbers (worked out in the page, no new turn), options to let the user pick. Plain rows and columns read fine as a Markdown table, and one number needs no view. Give the answer first, then the view. Never invent data; mark sample numbers and assumptions as such. Do not repeat the same data as text, chart and table. Add only the controls the user needs. A view with options, confirm, form or submit ends your turn, and the answer arrives as the user's next message. Never collect a key, token or password. Keep the view under 8 KB.

title.description: Optional short heading shown above the view

view.description: One component { type, ...props }. Layout: stack (children, top to bottom) and row (children, side by side, wraps when narrow), 1 to 16 children; the outermost may define let: { name: "formula" }. Display: text ({ text: Markdown, tone?: "muted" }), metric ({ label, value, tone?: good|warn|bad, caption? }), table ({ columns: [{ key, label }], rows: [[cells]] }), chart ({ kind?: bar|hbar|line|area|donut, categories: [labels], series: [{ name?, values: [numbers] }], unit?, caption? }; donut takes one series), progress ({ label?, percent 0-100, or value with max, valueLabel?, tone? }), callout ({ text, tone?: info|good|warn|bad }), sources ({ items: [{ label, url }] }), html ({ html, summary, height? }: only for what nothing else can draw; it runs sandboxed with no network, cannot submit, and should use the CSS variables --bt-ink, --bt-ink-2, --bt-line, --bt-card, --bt-accent, --bt-green, --bt-star, --bt-danger). Inputs, which keep their value in the page: slider ({ id, label, min, max, step?, value, unit? }), number ({ id, label, value, min?, max?, step?, unit? }), choice ({ id, label, options: [{ label, value }], value? }), toggle ({ id, label, value? }); an input id is a plain name such as price. A metric value, caption or tone, a text, a progress field, a callout, a table cell or a chart value may be a formula { "=": "expression" } over input ids and let names: numbers, 'text', + - * / %, < <= > >= == !=, && || !, a ? b : c, and min max abs floor ceil sqrt pow round clamp fixed(x, digits) format(x, digits) percent(x, digits). Answers, which end your turn: options ({ id, options: [{ label, description? }], multi? }), confirm ({ id, confirmLabel?, cancelLabel? }), form ({ id, fields: [{ id, label, placeholder? }], submitLabel? }), submit ({ id, label }: sends the inputs' values to you).

await_reply.description: Wait for the user to submit the view. A view with options, confirm, form or submit always waits; a view without them cannot.

initial.name: skill
initial.description: Load the full instructions for a skill. Call it before acting on a task that names or clearly matches a skill in the session skill catalog.

name.description: The exact skill name from the available skills list.

initial.name: stop_bot
initial.description: Main Bot only. Stop another Bot's running turn immediately — when it must not finish a dangerous action and a message_bot warning is not enough. Its queued messages are dropped with the turn. It is then told why in a new turn, whose reply comes back to you.

reason.description: Why it was stopped; it reads this afterwards

initial.name: subagent
initial.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. It runs in the background by default and returns a subagent id you can continue with `send_message`; you are notified when the run settles.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs.

run_in_background.description: Defaults to true. Set false only when your next action depends on the result.

initial.name: subagent_fork
initial.description: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation: a child agent seeded with all completed turns so far (it does not see the current in-flight turn). Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. It runs in the background by default and returns a subagent id you can continue with `send_message`; you are notified when the run settles.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.

run_in_background.description: Defaults to true. Set false only when your next action depends on the result.

initial.name: todo_update
initial.description: Update one existing task without resending the list; task must match its full text. Use status completed with start_next true to finish that task and start the first pending task when no other task is in progress. Repeating an already completed task does not advance again. Use todo_write to add, rename, remove, or reorder tasks. While work remains, keep the todos being worked on `in_progress`, several only when work runs in parallel. After each stage, verify its actual result and immediately update the completed task and the work now in progress. Keep unfinished or failed work pending or in_progress; do not wait until final delivery to update all tasks at once. Generation success does not complete editing, quality checks, or delivery.

task.description: Exact content of the existing task; surrounding whitespace is ignored.

status.description: Actual task state: pending, in_progress, or completed.

start_next.description: Only with completed: on a new completion, start the first pending task if no task remains in_progress.

initial.name: todo_write
initial.description: Record and update a task list to plan multi-step work and show progress; skip it for trivial single-step tasks. Add one todo per concrete step before you start. Use this tool to create or revise the whole plan; use todo_update for individual status changes. While work remains, keep the todos being worked on `in_progress`, several only when work runs in parallel. After each stage, verify its actual result and immediately update the completed task and the work now in progress. Keep unfinished or failed work pending or in_progress; do not wait until final delivery to update all tasks at once. Generation success does not complete editing, quality checks, or delivery.

todos.description: The COMPLETE task list, replacing any previous list.

content.description: What the task is — a short imperative line.

initial.name: tool_context
initial.description: Manage your own tool definitions. status lists loaded and pinned tools. load exposes exact tools for this session. pin also saves them for future sessions of your Bot when supported. release removes session loading and the pin; unpin removes only the future-session preference and keeps currently loaded tools. Constant base tools, tool_search and tool_context cannot be released. Changes apply to your next model request; historical definitions and results remain in conversation history. Search can load a released tool again. This does not grant permissions or change other Bots.

operation.description: Read status, load for this session, pin for future sessions, release, or cancel a pin.

tools.description: Exact tool names; required for changes. Use tool_search to find names.

initial.name: tool_search
initial.description: Find authorized tools not loaded upfront by task or exact name; matching full definitions load next step. With no arguments, list capability groups without loading tools. Supply capability alone to browse and load a group, or combine it with query to narrow a search. A category query with no matches also searches globally. If results are omitted, use next_offset or narrow the query. No match does not establish that a capability is unavailable. Search does not execute tools.

query.description: Task description or exact tool name; supports Chinese and English. Omit both query and capability to list capabilities.

capability.description: Optional capability id from the directory. Omit to search across groups.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset for the same query or capability; use next_offset from an earlier result. Defaults to zero.

limit.description: Maximum matching tools to load, from 1 to 8; defaults to 8.

initial.name: update_bot
initial.description: Change a Bot's name, role, color, profile picture, model, thinking level, working folder, or instructions. Every Bot may change itself; only a Main Bot may change another Bot.

bot.description: Current name of the Bot to change; leave out to change yourself

preset.description: Registered preset for future new Sessions of this Bot. Its current conversation and preset remain intact.

resident_tools.description: Replacement exact-name resident tools. An empty list clears residency; existing permissions still apply. Use tool_context to adjust your own active tools.

color.description: One of deepseek, blue, violet, orange, green, magenta, cyan, red, yellow, brown, gray, black, aurora, charcoal, graphite, rose, sky, tangerine, cobalt

avatar.description: Profile picture: a local image path (a relative path starts in your working folder) or a data URL. PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF; square, 256x256 recommended, up to 120 KB. Images are not resized. An empty string removes the photo and shows the Bot's character again.

model.description: Move the Bot to another model, as provider/model or a model id

effort.description: Thinking level for the Bot's model, as list_models shows; an empty string returns to the model's default

work_dir.description: Full path of the folder to work in, where commands and file tools start. Only when the user asks for it; an empty string returns it to the team workspace

initial.name: update_goal
initial.description: Update the current goal.

revision.description: Exact positive revision returned by get_goal.

action.description: edit, pause, and resume require a direct top-level human request. complete and blocked are also allowed during an automatic continuation of this goal; blocked is rejected before the configured minimum round count. wait yields the foreground while keeping the goal active; resume on user input, watched job output, or a timer.

objective.description: Replacement objective; valid only with action edit.

max_goal_rounds.description: Replacement cap; valid only with action edit.

blocked_reason.description: Required only with action blocked: the concrete condition that persisted across rounds and blocks progress.

wait_reason.description: With action wait: describe what new information or event is needed.

wake_after_seconds.description: With action wait: optional positive whole seconds before continuing.

job_id.description: With action wait: optional owned job to watch for new output or settlement.

initial.name: update_group
initial.description: Change a group chat: rename it, set its notice, add or remove members, change its admin or reply mode. Main Bots may change any group; a group's admin may change its own group.

group.description: Exact group chat name from list_bots

name.description: New group name; an empty string names it after its members again

notice.description: Replacement notice, the shared instructions every member reads; an empty string clears it

add_members.description: Exact names of Bots to add

remove_members.description: Exact names of Bots to remove

admin.description: Member to make the admin; "none" leaves the group without one (Main Bots only)

mode.description: "everyone": every member answers a plain message in turn, admin first. "admin" (the default): a plain message goes to the admin, who calls others with @Name. @mentions always choose who answers.

work_dir.description: Full path of the folder to work in, where commands and file tools start. Only when the user asks for it. Every member works there in this group; an empty string lets each member work in its own folder again (Main Bots only)

initial.name: video_inspect
initial.description: 查看视频并完成逐集画面观察。scan自动扫描整集的切镜和镜头内显著画面变化，不能选择帧数或跳过区间；默认scan。next逐批返回全部关键帧的真实图片；observe按frame_id逐张记录具体画面、变化和疑点。status读取全部进度与记录。完成当前用途后可自主close结束后续跟进，不改真实完成度；reopen校验原视频版本后恢复跟进。review_id可选择已保存记录，status和close无需读取原视频。events可把已记录帧归为动作事件；transcript_path读取已保存ASR并保留原段，列出连续发言候选。timeline按实际时间并列记录、事件笔记和ASR；时间窗不是换场或动作分界，不自动编造动作。compare配合draft_path只读对照事件、对白时间与实际正文，不自动判定覆盖或拦截交付。待查看或未记录帧保留为当前视频的证据缺口，不拦截Word导出或present。不把声学编号当角色身份，不凭单帧编造动作。

file_path.description: 当前集实际完整视频路径；与review_id至少提供一项，同时提供时须指向同一记录。

review_id.description: 本会话已保存的review_id；不按集号或其他来源回退。status和close可仅凭此ID操作保存状态。

reason.description: close或reopen的可选原因；不改变未查看、未记录帧。

episode.description: 首次scan时标记集号；省略则使用实际视频路径。

method.description: 默认scan；next查看下一批，revisit重显已记录原图，observe逐图记录，events保存动作事件表；status读取进度，timeline并列时间线，compare对照当前稿，metadata只读元数据。close结束当前来源后续跟进，不补记图片；reopen校验来源后恢复，不重新扫描。

timeline_start_seconds.description: timeline可选的来源开始秒数；仅选择核对材料，不改变全片扫描和观察进度。

timeline_end_seconds.description: timeline可选的来源结束秒数；局部材料不代表整集已核对。省略则到本集结尾。

frame_ids.description: revisit需要重看的已记录frame_id，数量不超过当前批上限；返回缓存原图及原观察，不重新抽帧、不重置记录。

draft_path.description: compare使用的本集已保存UTF-8剧本路径；返回完整正文与时间顺序观察记录，不写稿、不自动审核。Word请使用其对应文本源稿。

transcript_path.description: 可选本集audio_transcribe已保存JSON路径；返回原段、时间、声学编号和相邻同号连续发言候选，不改原话、不推定角色姓名。close、reopen及仅凭review_id的status不读取ASR。

event_groups.description: events使用；替换当前完整事件表，空数组清空。连续多帧可支持一个动作；只引用已记录frame_id，保留不确定性，不按帧数凑事件。

observations.description: observe时按实际返回的frame_id逐图记录；不能用“已查看”或“同上”代替内容。

visible.description: 具体可见人物、位置、动作、神态或道具；至少8个字符。

change.description: 与邻近画面的变化；无变化也需据实说明。

uncertainty.description: 需要补看前后画面才能澄清的具体疑点；没有时可省略。填写具体疑点会安排前后补帧。

initial.name: web_fetch
initial.description: Fetch the content of a specific HTTP(S) URL and return it decoded to text.

initial.name: web_search
initial.description: Search the web for current information. Returns an optional summary answer and a list of source URLs.

queries.description: 1–4 search queries; their results are merged.

initial.name: workflow
initial.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf — no pattern/format/numeric bounds) it resolves to the validated object, and the child must call its `structured_output` tool to report it: a `schema` call whose child answers in plain text resolves `null`. If the prompt text states its own return format, that text describes the payload, never the reporting channel. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides (either may be provided alone). Anything else (`effort`/`isolation`/`agentType`) is rejected loudly.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. An ordinary stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

initial.name: write
initial.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.
